messages:
kai (product): quick sync 1 — Ledgerly wants a tight SLA for /v1/charge during daily settlement windows. asks: per-route guarantee, optional no-preempt days, and clear overage invoicing. need scope for next sprint.

sam (eng-platform): option A: add per-route lease metadata and priority tags (fast). Option B: materialize separate pools (slow). prefer A.

nora (eng-sre): ops: preemption by route is safer. propose default fallback sequence: queue 50ms -> quantized fallback -> reject(429). need kill-switch + preempt audit log.

ella (billing): billing needs per-lease export: lease_id, route, tokens_used, window_start. include dispute window (48-72h). recommend billing line item for no-preempt days.

mohit (sales): Ledgerly will pay for predictable latency. wants invoice preview and sample SLA credit formula. also asked if dominance windows (temporary higher priority) are possible.

sam (eng-platform): dominance windows are doable as a temporary weight bump on lease. plumbing estimate: 6 dev-days to wire metadata -> scheduler, 2d telemetry, 2d billing hooks. ~10d parallelizable.

nora (eng-sre): gating for pilot: telemetry + preemption logs, rollback toggle, billing export validated, and canary dry-run with synthetic spike. ops will cover first 48h.

kai (product): action items: 1) sam/nora prototype per-route lease in sandbox, 2) ella draft billing export + invoice stub, 3) mohit get Ledgerly numbers for X/Y. decision by Fri EOD.

ops-bot: scheduled sandbox dry-run 2025-08-12T02:00:00Z. :rocket:

sam (eng-platform): will spin up prototype today and post results.

nora (eng-sre): will add audit log schema and chaos test.

kai (product): keeping pilot minimal: one lease, two routes, one month log retention. will expand after pilot validation. :white_check_mark:
